## Monitoring performance recovery

- Snapshot, Monitoring cards, Overview, and full-history APIs now use indexed compact projections across all telemetry, restoring low-latency reads while exact ingest and immediate liveness remain unchanged.
- Smaller improvements add a stable fleet-wide Compact/Comfortable grid, cancellation-safe request coalescing, exact multi-interface vnStat reconstruction during reimports, editable shared views, raw/ratio sorting, and complete alert-history reporting.
